entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 1908, Standbuch 1011
entries.summary: Anselm von Rosenbergs Pfandherrschaft über den Zehnten von Püssensheim wird um weitere zwei Jahre verlängert.
entries.german: Darnach im 1446 Jahre ist ime die inhabung vnd nutzung itzgedachtem zehenden noch 2 Jare erstreckt eod. lib. fo 76
entries.english: The archive summary identifies the previously mentioned tithe as the one over which Anselm von Rosenberg held pledge rights at Püssensheim. The transcription states that his possession and use of it were extended for another two years in 1446. Recorded in the same book, fol. 76.

facts.content: continued to hold and use the tithe at Püssensheim for two further years.
